topPRs.title: op-deployer: fix live sepolia upgrade tests
topPRs.author: Inphi
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Fix live Sepolia op-deployer tests after the recent Sepolia upgrade.

- Enable `CannonKona` in the OPCM V2 live upgrade test config, matching Sepolia’s current `respectedGameType = 8`
- Replace a stale hard-coded Sepolia `SuperchainConfigImpl` expectation with the live proxy implementation read via `ProxyAdmin`

## Testing

- `SEPOLIA_RPC_URL=<EKANS> go test ./op-deployer/pkg/deployer/integration_test ./op-deployer/pkg/deployer/pipeline -run 'TestEndToEndBootstrapApplyWithUpgrade|TestInitLiveStrategy_OPCMReuseLogicSepolia' -count=1 -v`
- `go test ./op-deployer/pkg/deployer/upgrade/embedded -count=1`
- `git diff --check`
